name: Playtest lens — play the compiled case in the lab
problemStatement: The lab has a Playtest lens next to Script and Canvas that loads any compiled case: first a content display where every emitted entity renders in its player surface, then a playable loop probe answers whether the authored content plays
body:
## Decisions so far

- The destination is a playable content playthrough. A read-only content display is a milestone on the way, not a separate destination. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- The playtest surface lives as a third lens in the lab, next to Script and Canvas, over the same compiled case. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- The playtest lens grows from the SB-055 preview rail. The preview renderers are the seed, not a parallel implementation. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- Case-agnostic from day one: the lens renders whatever the compiler emits, not tiny-olsen specifically. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

- SB-078: the lab state is a MobX spine — shallow observable state + selection in model.ts, rebuild rides a reaction on caseText, status/worklist/inspector/highlight render via autorun. The compiler stays pure (result/graph are refs). Probe-surface mirrors exist for the smoke tests only; new panels read the observables. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

- SB-080: d3-force replaces the hand-rolled sim — Terje's play ruling after an A/B toggle, and it took tuning to win: cold drag reheat (0.08), whisper charge (-150, 350px reach), and a custom elliptical collide matching the card footprint (the legacy X_SQUEEZE anisotropy). Legacy sim deleted. Lesson carried to SB-081: d3 defaults assume dot graphs, budget a tune-to-match loop. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

- SB-081: d3-zoom + d3-drag own the camera and both drag machines — Terje approved after play, called it a big improvement. Wheel curve matched to the old exp factor, clickDistance(4) reproduces the click threshold, and the pan/node/port arbitration has its own smoke tests. Two rulings folded in: the +/- buttons now zoom about the viewport center (accepted), and the dot grid rides the camera transform (added on his play note). Scope-guard finding: render.ts kept its DOM but yielded its pointerdown listeners — the port preventDefault suppressed the mouse events d3-drag rides on. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

- SB-059: the compiler is already case-agnostic — every olsen hard-wire sits in the shell, 13 call sites in 6 files. The seam is `import.meta.glob` discovery + a `?case=` param + a path-aware `/__save-case`, and the case names itself in its `# Case:` header, so no manifest is needed. The generated `tinyOlsen.ts` module is NOT a load seam: nothing in the repo imports it. Filed as SB-083. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

- SB-060: the renderer seam is one cut — split render from mount. The SB-055 renderers read only CompileResult and are impure only in their closing `host.innerHTML =`. Return a lit-html `TemplateResult` and they serve three lenses, because the script lens already carries a byte-identical third copy of wireDocFrame and the card/doc renderers. onJump is the sole canvas coupling. The real cost is the CSS: every rule is id-scoped to `#preview`, and 4 of the 14 shared rules have already drifted. Extraction is SB-082, which now blocks the content-display milestone. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

- SB-060 scope correction for SB-061: the preview renders a player surface for 4 of 10 node kinds today (fact, document, hypothesis, question). tiltak, dispatch, clock, conversation, recipe, proposal and the day-script beats are new renderers, not extraction. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

- SB-060 follow-up: the shared renderers return lit-html `TemplateResult`, not HTML strings. SB-079 already made lit-html the panel idiom, so preview.ts is the last string-concatenation panel. lit escapes interpolations, so the hand-rolled `esc` helpers go away, and lit's DOM diff keeps the document iframe alive across a recompile instead of forcing a reload and a re-fit. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

- SB-058 engine scope: THE LENS RUNS DATA, NEVER CODE. The lens executes the slice's declarative data — predicates, effects, day beats, pending-document arrival — and never reimplements Godot-only code (clock ticks, sim projection, grete_alive, Frank). Clocks render as dead dials. Where compiler and engine disagree, the engine is the spec; the mismatches become compiler lints (SB-085). Player verbs: ask→lift, commit dispatch (instant effects), advance day. No hypothesis verb — the real game has no choose surface; a debug state panel hand-sets hypotheses/stage/facts. No persistence: every run starts clean, one reset button. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

- SB-083: the case seam is live — prototypes/shared/active-case.ts owns discovery (import.meta.glob over content/cases), the ?case param, the per-case localStorage key builders, and a validated path-aware /__save-case. The topbar file label is now a case picker; cross-links carry the case. Default = first sorted path (olsen). A minimal stub case under content/cases/stub/ proves the picker switches. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

- SB-082: the render seam is cut — prototypes/shared holds the pure lit surface renderers (surfaces.ts), the parameterized doc-frame + lightbox (doc-frame.ts, with an iframe re-render guard), node-kind.ts, unlock.ts, doc-preview.ts, and the class-scoped shared stylesheet + token layer (surfaces.css; drifted rules reconciled to canvas values). Both lenses render their preview through lit; the renderers have their first unit tests. SB-061 builds its six new surfaces against this frame. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)

- SB-085: five engine-mismatch diagnostics live in the compiler — cond-gate-dropped, cond-hypothesis-gate-dead, effect-open-conversation-noop, hypothesis-availability-advisory (info) and deliver-clock-id-dead. They keep warning severity because they report engine facts, and two of them legitimately fire on shipped tiny-olsen authoring, so the provenance zero-warning law now excludes those codes. On branch worktree-sb085-compiler-lints, unmerged. (wayfinder, 2026-08-09)
- SB-062: the loop skeleton is a frontier-traversal content-edge mapper, not a game loop. The lens shows the frontier with locked content greyed and its unlock sentence, every effect-carrying entity is triggerable with instant effects, and each action shows the opened/still-closed delta, to content exhaustion. Fresh composition over the SB-082 renderers and active-case.ts. Wireframes are inspiration only — nothing structural is adopted, chat/call render idioms may borrow. No hours budget, no economy enforcement, no verdict form. (Terje, 2026-08-09)

## Out of scope

- LitElement and custom elements for the surfaces. Shadow DOM blocks the shared `:root` token layer that both probes already agree on, all 27 common tokens identical. Revisit only if the Playtest lens needs one surface at two sizes on one page, which sits behind the engine-scope and loop-skeleton grills. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- Tailwind in the probes. It reaches only `src/styles.css` for the React dashboard today, and three things argue against extending it: `buildDocPreviewHtml` renders the doc surface inside an iframe that Tailwind cannot reach and whose CSS is the Godot texture source, the card CSS is a deliberate mirror of hand_card.tscn and canvas_detail_panel.gd that must stay diffable against Godot, and a shared class-scoped stylesheet already fixes the duplication that Tailwind would fix by rewriting every rule. The probes stay on plain CSS. (Terje, 2026-08-09)
- Retiring the dead half of `gen:olsen`. `src/content/blueprint/generated/tinyOlsen.ts` has no importer, but the same script also writes the live cross-repo `tiny_olsen_slice.json`. Splitting them is a core-loop contract call, not a playtest one. Recorded in the SB-059 resolution.
- The broken `render-doc.mjs` docId route (filed as SB-084, no sprint). Found during the SB-059 inventory, unrelated to this map.
- A second game implementation. The lab pinned rule stands: probes test design decisions faster than Godot, they never replace it. SB-058 drew the exact line: data, never code.
- Godot-side changes in lifelines-core-loop.
- New authored content. The map plays what the compiler already emits.
- Porting wireframes wholesale. Wireframes donate loop skeletons and render idioms, not code lineage.
- Moving hypotheses to the card hand, and the wider de-emphasis of hypotheses and clocks. Core-loop design fog, Terje undecided (SB-058 session). The sketch lives on SB-062 as input.
- Show-or-hide locked doors for the real player. The lens greys them with unlock sentences for content production. Whether the shipped game shows the locked door or hides it is core-loop design fog, informed by lens data. (SB-062 session)

comments.author: claude
comments.text:
Charting session 2026-08-09 (wayfinder). Surveyed all 48 core-loop wireframes with four research agents, grilled Terje on the destination, created the map and six tickets.

Survey shortlist (full reports in the session, key facts here):
- Slice-shaped playable loops: bestilt_papir_probe (documents/dispatches/clocks verbatim from the slice), frank_chat_r2_probe (runs/questions/frank_response in slice shape), one_desk_world_probe (full 5-min day loop, self-contained), desk_dossier_probe (document-handling loop), case_session_spike_v4/v5 (largest loops; v5 CHAT_SCRIPT gating resembles compiled weave), greybox_language_test (cleanest content/mechanics split, runtime content swap).
- Display shell idiom: lifelines_prologue_design_playground (surface + day + state-knob browser, no loop).
- Spec pages: case_ui_inventory (field checklist for every case surface), watch_panel_v2_composed (SAK/LOGG/PERSON tab spine), watch_panel_value_probe ("every row has a verb").
- Harness idiom: A/B/C variant nav + DOMSLISTE verdict form (sakskart_board, timepanel).
- Weak for this map: fridge, hjemmebesok (beats as code), phone_connector (needs per-contact lines the slice does not author), skill/HUD family (wrong domain).

Lab facts: SB-055 preview.ts already renders fact/document/question player surfaces (uncommitted, other session). CaseSlice shape lives in src/compiler/emit.ts. Olsen is hard-wired in vite caseSave(), gen:olsen, and the generated tinyOlsen.ts module.

Frontier: SB-058 (engine-scope grill) and SB-059 (case-agnostic plumbing research). SB-060 waits on SB-055 landing.

comments.text:
Session (wayfinder: renderer seam research): resolved SB-060, one [research] ticket this session. Read the committed tree at 2dd4af9 — SB-055's files are in, so the pre-verdict caveat is discharged.

Headline: the seam serves three lenses, not two. The script lens already carries a byte-identical copy of wireDocFrame and its own card/doc renderers, so extraction pays off duplication that exists today. The cut is render-vs-mount: the renderers read only CompileResult and are impure only in their closing host.innerHTML assignment. onJump is the single canvas coupling. The hidden cost is CSS — every rule is id-scoped to #preview, and 4 of 14 shared rules have already drifted between the two probe pages.

Fog graduated: SB-082 [task] Render module extraction, blocked by SB-060 (now done, so it is on the frontier). SB-061 re-wired to blockedBy SB-059 + SB-082. Scope correction recorded on the project: only 4 of 10 node kinds have a player surface today, so SB-061 writes six new renderers plus a beat surface.

No code changed. Working tree clean.

Fog graduated: SB-083 [task] builds the loading seam and now blocks the content-display milestone (SB-061); SB-084 files an unrelated broken CLI route found on the way; two items went to Out of scope. Open question for Terje, on SB-083: only one case exists on disk, so a picker is not verifiable until a second .case.md exists — a 10-line stub would do it. No code changed this session.

Templating ruling (Terje, 2026-08-09), recorded on the project body and folded into SB-082: the shared surface renderers return lit-html TemplateResult, not HTML strings. LitElement/shadow DOM and Tailwind are both out for the probes. Rationale on the ticket.

Housekeeping: the two SB-060 decision lines were lost when a parallel session rewrote the project body from a pre-SB-060 snapshot. Restored, and the SB-059 lines from that session are preserved. The project body is a shared document — re-read it right before a --body write, never patch from an old dump.

comments.text: Session (wayfinder: playtest engine scope grill): resolved SB-058, one [grill] this session. Four rulings on the ticket: (1) rung-3 scope, law THE LENS RUNS DATA, NEVER CODE — clocks are dead dials; (2) the engine is the spec, compiler↔engine mismatches become lints; (3) player verbs = ask→lift, commit dispatch (instant), advance day, plus a debug state panel — no hypothesis verb, the real game has no choose surface (gym only); (4) no persistence. Fog graduated: SB-085 [task] compiler lints (5 diagnostics); Terje's card-play loop sketch commented onto SB-062 as grill input; hypotheses-to-card-hand → Out of scope. Frontier now: SB-062 (loop-skeleton grill, unblocked), SB-082, SB-083, SB-085. No code changed.
